layer1.name: ShiftCover
layer1.one_liner: Last-minute shift backfill for independent pharmacies.
layer1.description: Matches pharmacies with locum pharmacists when a shift falls through. The founder's own access assumption is well evidenced; the red-team pass then found five further ways the idea dies, none of them tested.
layer1.outcome_note: Synthetic fixture. Not a real company and not counted toward separation statistics.

layer2.pins: PRD 5.4.1's acknowledged cost, made observable. A thorough red team adds five uncovered high-impact assumptions, which dilutes Evidence Quality and tightens the cap — but must NOT crater the sub-score that already has real primary evidence behind it. Market Access stays at 90 while the composite falls, because what changed is what we know we do not know. If a future change lets red-team assumptions push sub-scores down directly, the pipeline starts punishing its own thoroughness and the standing temptation becomes softening the red team.

assumptions.statement: At least 4 in 10 independent pharmacies contacted through the pharmacists' association directory reply to a cold outreach within a week

falsification_criterion.applies_to: independent pharmacies listed in the pharmacists' association directory
falsification_criterion.observation: send cold outreach to listed pharmacies and count replies within a week

assumptions.statement: No incumbent pharmacy rostering system ships last-minute locum matching within 12 months

falsification_criterion.applies_to: the three most-used pharmacy rostering systems
falsification_criterion.observation: review release notes and pricing pages for locum matching

assumptions.statement: At least 5 in 10 locum pharmacists already using an agency have switched agencies at least once in the past two years

falsification_criterion.applies_to: locum pharmacists currently working through an agency
falsification_criterion.observation: ask them to walk through how they found their last three placements
falsification_criterion.metric: count who have switched agencies in two years

assumptions.statement: At least 3 in 10 independent pharmacies have paid an agency premium above $40/hr for an emergency locum in the past year

falsification_criterion.observation: ask them to pull the invoice for their last emergency locum booking

assumptions.statement: Regulatory verification of locum credentials takes fewer than 3 business days in at least 4 of 5 sampled jurisdictions

falsification_criterion.applies_to: the five jurisdictions in the launch region
falsification_criterion.observation: submit a verification request in each and time the response
falsification_criterion.metric: count completing in under 3 business days

assumptions.statement: The founder can staff overnight support coverage for at least 5 nights a week without a second hire

falsification_criterion.applies_to: the founder's own schedule over one month
falsification_criterion.observation: log which nights were actually covered

claims.text: A pharmacy owner replied to a cold email within two days and booked a call.
A second owner replied the same week and described the shift-cover problem unprompted.
A third pharmacy replied and forwarded the request to two peers.
A fourth pharmacy did not reply within the week.
